.²1 Turning round, winding, revolving; {#pradakziRAvartaSiKaH#} <ls>Rām. 6. 73. 23</ls>.

 {#darSitAvartanABeH#} <ls>Me. 28</ls>; <ls>Dk. 2</ls>; {#AvartaH saMSayAnAm#} <ls>Pt. 1. 191</ls>.
.²3 Deliberation, revolving (in the mind), anxiety.
.²4 A lock of hair curling backwards, especially on a horse (considered
 lucky); {#AvartA yasya jAyante DanyaH sa turagottamaH#} ({#SAlihotra#} of {#Boja#}).
.²5 The two depressions of the forehead above the eye-brows.
.²6 A crowded place (where many men live closely together).
.²7 A kind of jewel.
.²8 <ab>N.</ab> of a form of cloud personified; {#Avarto nirjalo meGaH#}.

.²9 Melting (of metals).
